_comment: The campaign: the Underground Streetmon Racing League story in five acts. Quests are offered by people (npcs) when their prerequisites are met (quests done, story flags, Street Cred, league division), run their objectives in order, and pay out rewards (cash, Street Cred, items, tuning blueprints, legendary Streetmon, story flags). Objective types: REACH_MARKER, WIN_RACE, COMPLETE_HEIST, CATCH_STREETMON, DEFEAT_BOSS, REACH_STREET_CRED (the six core types) plus TALK_TO, ESCAPE_WANTED (raises the Wanted Level to `stars` when it starts; done when you've lost the police) and TUNE_VEHICLE (a car with `slots` Streetmon slotted). WIN_RACE can ask for a night race and put the police on you (`police` stars) when the race starts. Dialogue trees: nodes with numbered choices; a choice leads to another node, or 'accept', 'complete' or 'end'. Positions are world metres (x east, z south).

acts.title: The Chop Shop Rookie
acts.summary: You're the new kid at Mama Rust's Underground Chop Shop. Catch your first Streetmon, learn to tune, run some jobs, and beat the Waterfront's District Boss for a League Pass.

acts.title: High-Octane Turf
acts.summary: Pass in hand, you're in the USRL. Two crews own the downtown grids: the Smoke Syndicate and the Bassline Cartel. Take them both.

acts.title: The Vault Hijack
acts.summary: Late-game tuning and Grand Prix buy-ins cost real money. The Accountant knows where it is.

acts.title: Police Lockdown & Underground War
acts.summary: The Commissioner has the police on the League's payroll. Survive the crackdown, race the midnight sprints through the roadblocks, and break the tactical unit.

acts.title: The Apex Grand Prix & Syndicate Showdown
acts.summary: Qualify, win the three-stage Apex Grand Prix with the police on your tail, and take down Commissioner Varga.

bosses.name: Dockside Dutch
bosses.title: District Boss of the Waterfront
bosses.intro: You're Rust's new grease monkey? The docks are mine, kid. Beat me and maybe the League gives you a pass.
bosses.win: ...Fine. Take your League Pass. The docks will remember this.

bosses.name: Haze
bosses.title: Boss of the Smoke Syndicate
bosses.intro: You can't win what you can't see. My crew runs the smoke on every grid downtown.
bosses.win: The smoke clears... you're the real thing. Downtown's grids are open to you.
bosses.lose: Lost in the haze. Come back when you can see straight.

bosses.name: Subwoofer Sal
bosses.title: Boss of the Bassline Cartel
bosses.intro: Feel that? That's the Cartel. Every race downtown pays us a cut. You want to change that?
bosses.win: Bass dropped. Respect. The Cartel steps aside... for now.
bosses.lose: Turn it down, kid. You can't handle the volume.

bosses.name: Captain Hale
bosses.title: Police Tactical Commander
bosses.intro: You've been running my roadblocks all month. Tonight it ends. Tactical unit: deploy.
bosses.win: Stand down, everyone. ...The Commissioner's going to be furious.
bosses.lose: Cuff 'em. Kidding. Get out of my city.

bosses.name: Commissioner Varga
bosses.title: League Commissioner
bosses.intro: Do you know how much money this League makes me? Every buy-in, every bribe, every cop on the payroll. And you think you can take that away?
bosses.win: It's over. The League... belongs to the streets again.

blueprints.name: Cold Air Intake
blueprints.description: Breathes harder: +4% top speed, +6% acceleration on every car you drive.

blueprints.name: Drift Differential
blueprints.description: Tuned for the downtown grids: +6% grip, +8% steering.

blueprints.name: Vault-Grade Turbo
blueprints.description: Bought with bank money: +10% acceleration, +5% top speed.

blueprints.name: Tactical Roll Cage
blueprints.description: Lifted off a SWAT van: +25% durability.

blueprints.name: Apex Aero Kit
blueprints.description: The Grand Prix champion's kit: +5% speed and acceleration, +8% grip, +10% durability.

legendaries.description: Lived in the First Empire vault's wiring for years. Now she's yours.
The League's crown Streetmon, kept by the Commissioner. It answers to the champion.

quests.title: Mama's Welcome
quests.summary: Mama Rust shows you how to catch Streetmon, hands you some cuffs and lets you pick your first partner. Catch a wild one and bring it back.

objectives.text: Use your Streetmon to catch a wild one, then go back to Mama Rust

w1.text: Fresh off the night bus and you walk straight into my garage? You've got your father's nerve. Nobody gets far in this city without Streetmon, and you, kid, have none. Let's fix that.

w2.text: Wild ones live all over: alleys, rooftops, the sewers, the park. Knock one about with your own Streetmon till it's weak, then throw cuffs. Weaker means likelier. Out of a battle, face one and press C.

w3.text: Then you chase it, or you find another. Every miss on the same one makes the next throw likelier. Ground-level Streetmon outside the park won't start a fight. Park ones bite.

w4.text: Here: five pairs of cuffs, on the house. Now pick a partner from my back room. Whichever you take, use it to catch me one more and come back.

wa.text: One wild Streetmon. Weaken it, cuff it, come back. The alley behind the docks always has something skulking about.

wt.text: Two Streetmon already. You might just make it here. Take a few more cuffs, then let's talk engines.

quests.title: Grease Monkey
quests.summary: Mama's given you a car: the grey Rustbucket at the kerb. Lower it into the Chop Shop and slot a Streetmon into it.

objectives.text: Drive the Rustbucket onto the lift out front, press E, and slot a Streetmon into it

o1.text: Now the real work. Around here cars don't run on gas, they run on Streetmon. Slot the right one in the engine bay and a junker becomes a rocket.

o2.text: See the grey Rustbucket at the kerb? It's yours. Drive it onto the lift out front, slow, and press E. Down below, put one of your Streetmon in a slot. Smoke and Gun types go in the engine bay.

a1.text: Rustbucket on the lift, E, slot a Streetmon. It's not rocket science. Well. It is a bit.

t1.text: Look at that. You've got the hands for this. A Streetmon in a car rides with the car, not with you: pull it back out at the lift whenever you need it in a fight.

quests.title: Courier Run
quests.summary: Pick up a crate of parts from Foreman Pike's dock on West Ave and deliver it to the East Ave docks before the buyer leaves.

objectives.text: Meet Foreman Pike at the West Ave docks
objectives.line: Rust sent you? Good. The crate's on the loading bay by West Ave. Back a car up to it and don't scratch my paint.

objectives.text: Drive to the loading bay on West Ave
Deliver the crate to the East Ave docks

o1.text: Foreman Pike's got a crate of parts for us at the West Ave docks. The buyer's on the East Ave docks and he doesn't wait. Three minutes, door to door.

a1.text: Pike, West Ave docks. Then floor it across town.

quests.title: Small Time
quests.summary: Rust needs cash for the League Pass entry. Hit Quik Cash Check Cashing uptown.

objectives.text: Pull off the Quik Cash job (plan it at the gold ring nearby)

o1.text: A League Pass isn't cheap and the docks boss won't fight a nobody. Quik Cash uptown keeps its float in a back room. Bring a Breacher.

a1.text: Quik Cash. In, out, no heroics.

quests.title: The Docks Boss
quests.summary: Beat Dockside Dutch, the Waterfront's District Boss, to earn a USRL League Pass.

objectives.text: Defeat Dockside Dutch on the West Ave waterfront

o1.text: The League only takes racers a District Boss vouches for. Ours is Dockside Dutch. He won't vouch. So beat him.

o2.text: West Ave waterfront, by the old cranes. Concrete and Grind types. Bring something that bites through them.

a1.text: Dutch. West Ave waterfront. Bring Grind or Bass.

objectives.text: Win any league race (find an organizer on the map)

o1.text: A League Pass with Dutch's name on it? Ha. I'm Vex, I promote the downtown grids. Win one race and I'll start returning your calls.

a1.text: One win. Any track. The organizers are on your map.

quests.title: Up in Smoke
quests.summary: Catch a Bass-type Streetmon, then beat Haze of the Smoke Syndicate.

objectives.text: Catch a Bass-type Streetmon (Bass blows smoke away)
Defeat Haze on 5th Ave downtown

o1.text: The Smoke Syndicate fixes every race downtown. You can't overtake what you can't see. Their boss, Haze, takes challengers on 5th Ave.

o2.text: Bass types. Sound waves clear smoke. Catch one, then go knock on Haze's door.

a1.text: Bass beats Smoke. Catch one, then Haze, 5th Ave.

quests.title: Drop the Bass
quests.summary: Catch a Concrete-type Streetmon, then beat Subwoofer Sal of the Bassline Cartel.

objectives.text: Catch a Concrete-type Streetmon (Concrete beats Bass)
Defeat Subwoofer Sal on 8th Ave downtown

o1.text: Haze is out. Now the Cartel's taking a cut of every purse. Sal plays loud. Concrete doesn't care how loud.

a1.text: Concrete type, then Sal, 8th Ave at the bottom of town.

quests.title: The Harbor Run
quests.summary: With both crews beaten, win the Harbor Run.

objectives.text: Win the Harbor Run

o1.text: Both crews down. The Harbor Run is the downtown crown. Win it and you're Pro. The Commissioner will notice. That's good. Mostly.

a1.text: The Harbor Run organizer is on the east side. Go win.

t1.text: Pro Division. And the Commissioner's people are asking about you. Be careful what you buy next.

quests.title: Ice
quests.summary: Fund your late-game tuning: rob Diamond Row Jewelers.

objectives.text: Pull off the Diamond Row job (you'll need a Smoke type)

o1.text: Grand Prix buy-ins, turbos, a squad that can stand up to the Commission... that's money. I know where it is. Start with Diamond Row.

a1.text: Diamond Row. Smoke the guards before you touch a case.

quests.title: Rolling Bank
quests.summary: Hit the armored transport pickup downtown.

objectives.text: Pull off the Armored Transport job (4-minute window)

o1.text: The banks move the Commission's money in armored trucks. One sits at a pickup downtown for four minutes. Four.

quests.title: The Vault Hijack
quests.summary: Crack the First Empire Savings & Trust vault.

objectives.text: Pull off the First Empire vault job (Breacher and Hacker)

o1.text: The big one. First Empire's vault holds the Commission's slush fund. They say something lives in the vault's wiring, too.

a1.text: First Empire. Jam the alarm line before you breach.

t1.text: You actually did it. And you brought something back from the wiring. The Vault Queen. Keep her close.

quests.title: Crackdown
quests.summary: The Commissioner put a 5-star bounty on you. Lose the police.

objectives.text: Survive the 5-star crackdown: lose the police

o1.text: Hey. I'm Jinx, I live on the police scanner. Bad news: the Commissioner just called in a five-star crackdown with your name on it. Military, tanks, the lot. Want me to tell them where you are? Kidding. Run.

a1.text: Lose them! Break line of sight, change cars, go underground!

quests.title: Midnight Sprint
quests.summary: Win the Harbor Run at night, straight through the police roadblocks.

objectives.text: Win the Harbor Run at night (the police will be waiting)

o1.text: The illegal midnight sprints are back. The cops know the route and they're setting roadblocks on the Harbor Run. Win it anyway, after dark.

a1.text: Harbor Run, at night. Expect three stars and roadblocks.

quests.title: Break the Unit
quests.summary: Defeat Captain Hale and the police tactical unit.

objectives.text: Defeat Captain Hale on 10th Ave uptown

o1.text: Captain Hale runs the tactical unit. His Streetmon are all Gun types, and he's waiting for you on 10th Ave. Beat him and the Commissioner's out of cops.

a1.text: Hale. 10th Ave uptown. Concrete beats Gun.

quests.title: Qualifying
quests.summary: Reach 120 Street Cred and bring a weaponized ride: two Streetmon slotted in one car.

objectives.text: Reach 120 Street Cred
Slot two Streetmon into one car at the Chop Shop

o1.text: The Apex Grand Prix. Three stages across the city, and the Commissioner's cops chasing the leaders. Qualifying means 120 Street Cred and a car carrying two Streetmon.

a1.text: 120 Street Cred, two Streetmon in one ride.

quests.title: The Apex Grand Prix
quests.summary: Pay the $2,500 buy-in and win all three stages, then lose the police.

objectives.text: Stage 1: win the West Side Sprint
Stage 2: win the Uptown Switchback
Stage 3: win the Central Green Circuit with the police on you
Final stage: lose the Commissioner's pursuit

o1.text: Buy-in's $2,500. Three stages: the West Side Sprint, the Uptown Switchback, then the Central Green Circuit with the police in it. Then you've got to get away.

a1.text: Win the stages in order. Then shake the cops.

objectives.text: Defeat Commissioner Varga on 3rd Ave uptown

o1.text: You won the Grand Prix and the Commissioner didn't hand you the trophy. He wants to see you on 3rd Ave. Alone. His team is the best money can buy.

t1.text: The League belongs to the streets again. And this... this was the Commissioner's. The Apex. It's yours, champ.
